items.h: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Gordon leads options to replace Achane for Week 4 and beyond
items.s: Eric Karabell lists who he thinks are the top available players worth adding for the week ahead.

items.h: Holani returned five kickoffs for 133 yards in Sunday's 31-17 win over the Steelers.
items.s: Holani hasn't played an offensive snap through two weeks, but he continues to make an impact on special teams. As long as Kenneth Walker and Zach Charbonnet are healthy, Holani's role should remain the same.
